method: I started from 6,237 priced Kalshi legs in the next 36 hours and kept those priced 30–85¢ with an edge of about −2.5 or better, no flags, and one per game. I matched them by hand against today's 289 expert picks, because the dump again returned no automatic matches, and against Polymarket top-trader positions. A leg stayed only if at least two of these agreed: top-trader money, a published pick or model, and concrete injury or matchup news. A lone dissent was allowed only when it was at a different number with no reasoning (MacMillan's WVU +25.5). I dropped these conflicts: Broncos @ Steelers (most experts take Denver but top traders hold $36k on the Steelers ML and $83k against Broncos −4.5), Michigan @ Ohio State (experts split on the spread, and top traders are on the Over while experts take the Under), Texas @ Texas A&M (same Over vs Under split, plus a spread dissent), Nebraska @ Iowa (top traders on Nebraska, Rob Paul on Iowa), Devils/Flames and Oilers/Kraken (experts split), Pacers/76ers, Lakers/Spurs, Mavs/Suns and Bucks/Pistons (experts split), and Wolves ML (Edwards out, Predictem on Memphis). Knicks −3.5 had the top-trader money but its edge (−3.2) was too negative, so the Knicks ML is used instead. The ladder puts near coin-flips first and short favourites later, across Friday and Saturday.
honest: Every leg costs slightly more than its fair price after Kalshi's fee, so each bet's expected return is slightly negative and gets worse with every leg added.

ladder.game: Mississippi State Bulldogs @ Ole Miss Rebels
ladder.label: Ole Miss Rebels −17.5
ladder.why: Mississippi State QB Kamario Taylor is out for the season, and Covers' Rob Paul says the Bulldogs haven't covered since Week 5. Paul takes Ole Miss −17.5; SI's Iain MacMillan and Athlon's Tyler Schuster take −18.5, so all three clear this line. Top traders hold $6.2k on Ole Miss −17.5 and $393 against.

sources.name: Athlon Sports via Yahoo / Tyler Schuster (Ole Miss −18.5)

ladder.label: New York Knicks
ladder.why: OG Anunoby is out, but the Knicks have won six straight and are strong at MSG. Covers' Jon Metler makes New York about 63%, and Predictem, VegasOdds (−3.5) and TheRx (−4.5) all lay the points with the Knicks. No pick backs Miami. Top traders hold $2.6k on the Knicks ML against $405, plus $13k on Knicks −3.5.

ladder.label: LA Clippers
ladder.why: Brandon Ingram is back for the Clippers. New Orleans is without Dejounte Murray, Bennedict Mathurin is doubtful, and the Pelicans are 1-6 on the road while allowing 122.5 points a game (Predictem). Metler makes LA about 62% and the Dimers model about 64%. No pick backs the Pelicans.

ladder.game: NC State Wolfpack @ North Carolina Tar Heels
ladder.label: NC State Wolfpack +5.5
ladder.why: UNC's quarterback is hurt and the team is struggling (Covers' Rob Paul), and NC State has won the last five meetings and covered four (Forbes' Darren Cooper). Both take NC State +5.5. Top traders hold $347 on this side and none against. This leg is priced right at fair.

ladder.label: Louisville Cardinals
ladder.why: Louisville has won six straight and Kentucky has lost three in a row. Covers' Rob Paul (−2.5), SI's MacMillan (−3) and Covers' Chris Vasile (ML) all take Louisville, and no pick backs Kentucky. The Kentucky side has moved 8 points against since open. There is no top-trader money in this game.

ladder.label: Oregon Ducks −12.5
ladder.why: Oregon is 4-0 ATS during its win streak and Washington has offensive-line and efficiency problems (Rob Paul, −13.5). SI's Ryan Gilbert takes −14 after Oregon won by 38 at Michigan State and beat Michigan 31-7, and MacMillan also takes −14. All three clear this −12.5 line. Top traders hold a small $57 on it.

ladder.label: New York Rangers
ladder.why: Chicago is without Connor Bedard (Pickswise). Covers' Luc LeBlanc points to the Rangers' much better expected-goals share and the league's best penalty kill against a near-bottom Chicago. Top traders hold $1.1k on New York and none on Chicago.

ladder.label: Utah Utes −21.5
ladder.why: Covers' Rob Paul takes Utah −24.5, citing West Virginia's doubtful QB and a weak defense. SI's MacMillan has WVU +25.5 with no written reasoning; that is a different number, and any Utah win by 22–25 cashes both. Top traders hold $5.6k on Utah −21.5 and none against.

sources.name: Sports Illustrated / Iain MacMillan (WVU +25.5, at a different number)

ladder.game: Arizona State Sun Devils @ Arizona Wildcats
ladder.label: Arizona Wildcats −6.5
ladder.why: Arizona has the QB edge with Noah Fifita and Arizona State's pass defense is weak (Rob Paul, −7.5). SI's MacMillan takes −8.5. Top traders hold $287 on Arizona −6.5 and $3.1k against ASU +7.5.

ladder.game: Golden State Warriors @ Portland Trail Blazers
ladder.label: Portland Trail Blazers
ladder.why: Golden State is without Steph Curry (oblique), Jimmy Butler III, Moses Moody and Kristaps Porzingis, and has lost its last four road games without Curry by 21+ (Predictem). Portland is 12-6 with a top-5 offense (BettingPros). Metler, Ammirante and Jensen all back the Blazers, and top traders hold $912 on them with none against.

ladder.label: Toronto Raptors
ladder.why: Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard and RJ Barrett, but Brooklyn is 4-13 and 29th in defensive rating (BettingPros), and Toronto has a rest edge (Metler). Dimers' model likes Nets +7.5, but no one picks a Brooklyn win. Top traders hold $5.5k on Toronto against $317.
